audit_cohort.key_result: The 25K, Wikidata, and ListenBrainz estates are primarily lake/control artifacts and are not in the canonical serving path; catalog coverage omits Bronze and Serving.

No live-process P0, but current outputs fail normalization and publication gates: URI QIDs, dead location extraction, P31 pollution, broad venue classes, unsafe spill deletion, unbounded finalization, and no transactional generation manifest.

Reducers concatenate batch partials without global listener-artist aggregation before ranking, so duplicate fragments can consume TOP-25 slots; support thresholds are applied before global union and artist-day reduction also fails to aggregate globally.

Current Jaccard/cosine/lift use inconsistent universes, support 3 has no multiplicity control, TOP_25 is a computational policy, and pilot stability is weak. Candidate Gold thresholds require empirical calibration.
Malformed/colliding provider IDs, missing provenance, silent venue first-match behavior, and canonical/serving migration drift block Identity Graph V2.
Only 23.66% of MusicBrainz performer-place rows map through the current hand-maintained geography map; venue geography and historical outcome joins are not canonical.
82,547 MusicBrainz places are conflated with venues. A defensible candidate rail is 15,253 live-event-used places; capacity evidence is only 52 claims across 28 venues.

The historical 571-pair cohort is stale; only 530 were future and onsale in the August 25 snapshot reviewed on August 30. The candidate pool is large enough to evaluate a 5,000-pair target, but native IDs, freshness, longitudinal depth, and rights gates are missing.
The 25K artifact has zero API-verified channels. It has 10,607 artists with UC-shaped IDs, 4,018 noncanonical rows, and 25 ID collision values; blanket VERIFIED labels are invalid.

Existing import/backtest foundations are useful, but logical tenancy, a logical outcome vault, blind-export leakage, missing authenticated scope, and absent lifecycle controls block customer production use.

The product can support evidence-led proposed-show comparison and deterministic economics, but ticket evidence, recent-market progression, audience overlap, availability, and private deal facts remain incomplete.
Rights metadata does not propagate consistently into canonical/serving tables; listener-level ListenBrainz data and terms-uncertain commercial sources require quarantine or explicit approval.
Three GiB free disk, nonresumable Wikidata parallel reads, unbounded reducers/finalizers, and R2 small-object/read amplification require measured gates before the next heavy scan.
Release-blocking invariants are missing for provider ID quarantine, forward lifecycle, UNKNOWN-to-zero, global aggregation/restart, rights propagation, geography evidence, and serving parity.
Retain Arrow/PyArrow, DuckDB, and R2. Pilot Polars, Pandera, Iceberg, Splink-shadow, and bounded NetworkX only under equivalence gates; reject distributed-platform churn without measured need.
Generic analytics, CRM, and ticketing UI are commodity. The defensible wedge is a provenance/PIT public event graph joined to consented private settlement and outcome history.

ranked_findings.finding: Canonical and serving databases stop at migration 36 while repository product schemas reach migration 47. Major 25K/security and newer identity, ticket, and market products therefore exist in code/artifacts but not in the verified serving contract; the older core.entity_external_ids layer is present.
ranked_findings.gate: Apply migrations to a copy, materialize required tables, run content and endpoint parity, then publish an immutable snapshot.

ranked_findings.finding: Provider identifiers contain malformed values and one-to-many collisions; provenance is sparse and venue resolution can silently select a first match.
ranked_findings.gate: Provider validators, append-only assertions, explicit VERIFIED_EXACT/SUPPORTED_MULTI_SOURCE/CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT/MISSING states, and no order-based winner.

ranked_findings.finding: Affinity batch partials are concatenated without global listener-artist aggregation before ranking, artist-day partials are not globally aggregated, support filtering is partition-local, and published similarity labels use inconsistent denominator universes.
ranked_findings.gate: Global SUM before TOP_K, global support union, consistent N/n_a/n_b/x universe, corrected multi-credit handling, fixture counterexamples, clean checkpoint geometry, interruption/resume hash proof.

ranked_findings.finding: Rights and commercial-use states are not recursively enforced in canonical or serving products; pseudonymous listener-level rows are labeled commercially allowed without a documented privacy gate.
ranked_findings.gate: One authoritative registry, most-restrictive inheritance, listener quarantine, attribution manifests, and commercial serving blocked for unknown/research/internal/terms-review sources.

ranked_findings.finding: The running pass is operationally healthy but its current implementation emits URI QIDs, drops location relations, puts P31 type facts in external IDs, and cannot safely publish/delete spills transactionally.
ranked_findings.gate: QID/type/location fixtures, run-scoped spills, streaming compaction, canonical generation manifest, hash/count verification, complete lineage/metrics, and operator-approved recoverable garbage collection only after verified publication.

ranked_findings.finding: City/state strings and a bounded static map resolve only 23.66% of performer-place history and corrupt or miss historical engagement, venue, calendar, tape, and outcome joins.
ranked_findings.gate: Stable place/market IDs, source ancestry and coordinates, explicit raw-to-canonical resolution ledger, temporal event-location selection, and serving joins by ID.

ranked_findings.finding: The strongest near-term product is a proposed-show evidence workbench with explicit unknown/conflict/rights/PIT states, not a booking recommendation or composite artist score.
ranked_findings.gate: Two-proposal test covers identity, capacity claims, recent market plays, PIT competition, comps, deterministic economics, provenance, and a missing-evidence request list with no GO/BOOK output.

ranked_findings.finding: The 33,383-event Ticketmaster estate is a candidate pool large enough to evaluate a 5,000-pair structured target, but the current 571-pair claim is stale and lacks longitudinal price/inventory semantics.
ranked_findings.gate: 5,000 future/onsale native-ID pairs, <=24h freshness, >=95% structured success over two passes, explicit price basis/availability, and no OFFSALE/zero-listing to SOLD_OUT coercion.

ranked_findings.finding: MusicBrainz provides a plausible 15,253-place live-event candidate set, but all 82,547 places are currently treated as venues and only 52 capacity claims exist.
ranked_findings.gate: PLACE versus LIVE_MUSIC_VENUE eligibility, exact provider-ID links, ambiguity ledger, and 1,000 typed capacity/configuration evidence records without collapsing claims.

ranked_findings.finding: The 25K artifact labels 15,759 rows VERIFIED despite zero API verification; 11,719 unique UC-shaped ID values across 10,607 artists make a low-quota validation pass plausible after collision quarantine.
ranked_findings.gate: Separate API_VERIFIED/MB_OFFICIAL_LINK/WIKIDATA_LINK/INVALID_SHAPE/API_INVALID/MISSING, quarantine collisions, preserve raw response hash and retrieved_at, and correct quota accounting.

ranked_findings.finding: Private settled outcomes are the hypothesized highest-upside moat, but production requires physical tenant boundaries, encryption, authenticated scope, consent/retention/deletion, blind reveal controls, and field-level PIT metadata.
ranked_findings.gate: Two-tenant cross-read denial, encrypted vault/reveal audit, streaming PII quarantine, no serving leakage, field-level availability, export/deletion/revocation, and reconciliation tests.

ranked_findings.finding: The repository lacks end-to-end production invariants for provider IDs, forward lifecycle, UNKNOWN-to-zero, geography evidence, global restart idempotence, rights inheritance, and serving parity.
ranked_findings.gate: Add production-format fixtures and canonical/serving checks; missing schemas return NOT_EVALUATED or fail, never zero.

ranked_findings.finding: Nonresumable source reads, unbounded final buffers/reducers, tiny objects, and R2 health read amplification create material operational risk with only about 3 GiB local free space.
ranked_findings.gate: Single heavy job, explicit free-disk minimum, RSS/disk/network/object metrics, bounded pagination, and resumable or measured reread behavior.

ranked_findings.finding: Arrow/PyArrow, DuckDB, and R2 are adequate. Commodity dashboards, CRM, social breadth, and distributed data platforms do not create the moat; consented outcomes plus evidence/PIT semantics do.
ranked_findings.gate: Adopt a new tool only after output-equivalence and measured runtime/memory wins; pursue licensed partnerships instead of scraping proprietary competitor networks.

positions: A2 found no live-process P0 and recommended not stopping it.
A13 rejected production acceptance because the parallel path is nonresumable and local disk is constrained.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Do not stop the launchd-managed run solely for audit findings. Treat any output as provisional and require a corrected rebuild before canonical publication.

positions: The existing pilot uses shared support >=3.
A4 proposed support >=10 and node support >=50 as conservative candidates.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Reject both as validated Gold thresholds. Preserve >=3 only as Silver exploratory evidence; calibrate Gold with consistent estimators, FDR, and stability tests.

positions: A12 considers pseudonymous listener-level outputs a P0 privacy/governance risk.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Quarantine listener-level rows and serve only artist-level aggregates after privacy and rights review.

positions: The current canonical table materializes all places as venues.
A7 supports only 15,253 live-event-used candidates as the initial defensible rail.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Retain all source places but count venue securities only after typed eligibility and provenance gates.

positions: The promoted artifact labels every row VERIFIED.
A9 found zero API-verified rows and 10,607 artists with UC-shaped candidate IDs.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Reject blanket VERIFIED; reclassify by proof state before API validation.

positions: The prior milestone reports about 571 active pairs.
A8 found only 530 future/onsale pairs using stale Aug 25 evidence.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Use 530 only as a stale lower-quality snapshot, rebuild from current official status, and require explicit freshness for the 5,000 target.

positions: Existing migrations describe tenant and outcome-vault foundations.
A10 found no enforced tenant isolation or cryptographic vault boundary.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Accept the research workflow, reject production security claims, and implement P0 controls before any customer pilot.

positions: Iceberg, Polars, Splink, and generic orchestration could reduce engineering work.
A15 found the current Arrow/DuckDB/R2 foundation adequate and prior generic-tool trials negative.
explicit_disagreements.coordinator_decision: Run narrow equivalence benchmarks only; no platform migration until a measured bottleneck exists.
